freeze_rule: Commit before diagnostic values, fixture generation, candidate evaluator or numerical tests. No tuning after measurement.
scope: Matched-convention independent clock reference qualification before combined observer-arrival validation; retain unsuccessful qualification. Research evidence only, no production converter.

clock_contract.model: Astropy Time._get_delta_tdb_tt -> ERFA dtdb; site contribution once
clock_contract.ut_argument: UTC fraction used as approximation to UT1 by pinned Astropy implementation
clock_contract.site: WGS84 longitude, cylindrical radius and z in km
clock_contract.clarification: This records the existing selected algorithm, not a change to its physics or an assertion UTC equals UT1.

routes.execution: PINT 1.1.7 Observatory.get_TDBs default, no TOA pipeline
PINT 1.1.7 get_TDBs(method=ephemeris, ephem=DE421); retain exception, no fallback

routes.anticipated_limitation: USNO Circular 179 equation 2.6, no observer-site arguments; different approximation

routes.execution: explicit dtdb with selected UTC approximation and site inputs
routes.anticipated_limitation: same ERFA backend; dispatch reproduction only

diagnostic_design.selection: all Mission 38 dates x sites x hours, deduplicated over target direction; do not report 288 independent clock samples
diagnostic_design.paired_differences: PINT minus Astropy site and explicit ERFA UTC minus Astropy site are shared-backend controls. Skyfield minus Astropy geocentre, site minus geocentre, UT1 minus UTC are diagnostic convention differences only.
diagnostic_design.tolerance_rationale: 1 ps engineering check of wrapper/argument reproduction, never independent accuracy or physical uncertainty. No acceptance threshold for mismatched clock differences.
diagnostic_design.retain: Every row, signed differences and complete denominators; no fitting, centering or exclusions based on residual.

combined_gate.solar_inventory: reuse all Mission 40 historical rows, preserving domain rejection reasons
combined_gate.requires: all qualification requirements for at least one evidenced route
combined_gate.when_unsatisfied: all combined comparisons blocked, output and residual null; retain all reasons and count zero executed
combined_gate.no_automatic_promotion: Small or zero differences, passing unit tests, matching declarations, checksums and named third-party packages cannot establish independent physical reference accuracy.

sources.role: default delegation and unsupported ephemeris route; installed source hashes authoritative
UTC approximation to UT1 and site argument dispatch; installed source hash authoritative
installed tdb_minus_tt source cites USNO Circular 179 equation 2.6; geocentric-only inputs
installed ERFA documentation: UT1 definition, SOFA lineage, FB90 geocentric and approximate topocentric model; no borrowed physical bound

next_gate_if_unsuccessful: Acquire and qualify a separately implemented/integrated time-ephemeris reference, establish scale/rate/epoch/site mapping and domain uncertainty before any combined comparison; do not silently replace the selected convention.
